description: Sri Lanka - Solar Radiation Measurement Data is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Measurement stations, Renewable energy", published or maintained by CSP Services GmbH (World Bank Group). Data repository for measurements from 2 automated solar measurement stations in Sri Lanka. Summary measurement reports and measurement data ( 1 minute average values for global, direct and diffuse broadband solar irradiance, temperature, humidity, air pressure, liquid precipitation, wind speed and direction). Coverage: Sri Lanka. It has 10 files in PDF, XLSX, CSV. The portal files it under Measurement stations, Renewable energy, Resource assessments, Solar. The portal gives 2026 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
